name: 시나리오 1 합성(composed)
source: Rows are what happens in the home: where the resident is (fridge, table, sofa), device events, phone arrivals and when the viewer leaves. Every photo row has its capture time and the VLM answer lag (1.5-2.0 s; measured average nano 1.6 s, mini 1.8 s) at the system's VLM interval. The replay builds each photo from the phone camera at that moment (the spot the phone stands at, facing that spot's look_at, landscape 40 deg vertical view, 1.15 m, 10 deg down): only what is inside that view is in the photo. Frame references copy only the recorded VLM cup and drinking observations. Phone arrivals come after the go command plus the straight-line walk at 0.8 m/s. PAM answers after the first watching answer.
composed submit_plan response for this fixture; original cup id bound by the planner

name: back
source: composed: the resident leaves the table and comes back to the same meal; the phone stays at the table watch spot

name: brief
source: composed: the viewer stands, is briefly hidden, then sits again; the zone is never empty for 2 s

name: manual
source: composed external power off; the TV rule stops watching, so photos return to 2 s

name: cadence_wrong
source: deliberately wrong: keeps 1 s photos after a manual off, when the TV rule no longer watches

name: lag_missing
source: deliberately wrong: a photo row without lag would arrive at its capture time

name: lag_zero
source: deliberately wrong: an answer cannot arrive at its capture time

name: arrive_early
source: deliberately wrong: the phone reaches the table watch spot before it could walk there after the go command
